GOBBONET_BASE_URL_COMMENT: Base URL of the local GobboNet server.
LLM_DIRECT_BASE_COMMENT: Base URL of the direct local LLM server used for background summarizing/classifying.
LLM_DIRECT_TIMEOUT_COMMENT: Seconds to wait for the direct LLM before giving up.
GENERATION_TIMEOUT_COMMENT: Seconds to wait for a GobboNet chat reply before giving up.
PAGE_READY_TIMEOUT_COMMENT: Seconds to wait for the GobboNet page/state to become ready at startup.
MAX_BUBBLE_LINES_COMMENT: Maximum number of lines the speech bubble grows to before it scrolls.
MAX_RAW_CONTENT_CHARS_COMMENT: Truncates the raw accessibility text before sending it out. Set to 0 to disable truncation.
MAX_SUMMARY_CHARS_COMMENT: Truncates the returned screen-summary text to this many characters.
SUMMARY_MAX_TOKENS_COMMENT: Token limit for the background screen-summary generation call.
SUMMARY_TEMPERATURE_COMMENT: Sampling temperature for the background screen-summary generation call.
CLASSIFIER_MAX_TOKENS_COMMENT: Token limit for the emotion classifier call.
CLASSIFIER_TEMPERATURE_COMMENT: Sampling temperature for the emotion classifier call.
CLASSIFIER_INPUT_CHARS_COMMENT: Truncates the message text before it's handed to the emotion classifier. Set to 0 to disable truncation.
PROACTIVE_CHECK_PERIOD_MIN_COMMENT: Default minimum seconds between proactive opportunities (used by any profile that doesn't set its own rate).
PROACTIVE_CHECK_PERIOD_MAX_COMMENT: Default maximum seconds between proactive opportunities.
PROACTIVE_PROBABILITY_COMMENT: Default chance (0-1) that a proactive opportunity actually triggers. At each opportunity, if this roll fails, nothing happens and it just reschedules.
PROACTIVE_ENABLED_COMMENT: Master switch for proactive screen-watching. Same as the right-click 'Enable Proactive' checkbox.
AUTO_SWITCH_PROFILE_ON_SELECT_COMMENT: When on, picking a character from the Character menu (or GobboNet switching characters on its own) automatically loads that character's profile. When off, only 'Load Profile' switches profiles manually -- except the very first character detected after launch, which always tries to auto-load its profile. Same as the right-click 'Auto-switch Profile on Character Select' checkbox.
DEFAULT_EMOTION_COMMENT: Emotion tag used as a fallback whenever a requested/classified emotion isn't recognized.
FALLBACK_TRANSPARENT_COLOR_COMMENT: Window color-key used ONLY when no sprite is loaded, so the gray placeholder box stays visible. When a real sprite sheet is loaded, its own top-left pixel is sampled and used instead.
